assessments.name: Project development level 1
assessments.description: Group presentations on initial project development. Groups will made to bring together students from various backgrounds. This will mimic real-world challenges of collaboration.

assessments.name: Project development level 2
assessments.description: Individual presentations focusing on the development of sustainable design and building performance-related specific targets. Students to emphasize one of the themes of the degree from a list of given themes.

assessments.name: Project development level 3
assessments.description: Individual presentations focusing on the development of sustainable design and building performance-related specific targets.

assessments.name: Report on applied themes
assessments.description: Students will prepare a report with the details of the themes incorporated in their design.
